程序包 org.bukkit.spawner

接口 BaseSpawner

所有已知子接口:
CreatureSpawner, Spawner, SpawnerMinecart, TrialSpawnerConfiguration
@NullMarked public interface BaseSpawner
代表一个基础实体刷怪笼。
可能是 SpawnerMinecart、CreatureSpawner 或 TrialSpawnerConfiguration。

原文： Represents a basic entity spawner.
May be a SpawnerMinecart, CreatureSpawner or TrialSpawnerConfiguration.

    • getRequiredPlayerRange

      int getRequiredPlayerRange()
      获取玩家使刷怪笼激活所需的最远距离.
      如果该值小于或等于0, 则此刷怪笼永远处于激活状态.
      默认值为 16.

      原文： Get the maximum distance(squared) a player can be in order for this spawner to be active.
      If this value is less than or equal to 0, this spawner is always active (given that there are players online).
      Default value is 16.

      返回:
      激活刷怪笼所需最远距离

      原文：the maximum distance(squared) a player can be in order for this spawner to be active.

    • setRequiredPlayerRange

      如果设置小于或等于0的值, 将使刷怪笼永远处于激活状态.

      原文： Set the maximum distance (squared) a player can be in order for this spawner to be active.

    • getSpawnRange

      int getSpawnRange()
      获取刷怪笼刷怪区域的半径.
      这个区域形为正方形, 以刷怪笼所在地为中心, 向 x,z 轴方向延伸(不含刷怪笼本身).
      这个区域以刷怪笼的y轴(它的底部)为中心算起, 高2个方块, 这允许生物有足够空间在这个区域的顶部和底部平面下一格方块的区域内生成.
      默认值为 4.

      原文： Get the radius around which the spawner will attempt to spawn mobs in.
      This area is square, includes the block the spawner is in, and is centered on the spawner's x,z coordinates - not the spawner itself.
      It is 2 blocks high, centered on the spawner's y-coordinate (its bottom); thus allowing mobs to spawn as high as its top surface and as low as 1 block below its bottom surface.
      Default value is 4.

      返回:
      刷怪半径

      原文：the spawn range

    • getSpawnedEntity

      @Nullable EntitySnapshot getSpawnedEntity()
      获取将由此刷怪笼生成的 EntitySnapshot，如果未为此刷怪笼分配任何实体则返回 null。

      刷怪笼中所有适用的数据都将被复制，例如自定义名称、生命值和速度。

      原文： Gets the EntitySnapshot that will be spawned by this spawner or null if no entities have been assigned to this spawner.

      All applicable data from the spawner will be copied, such as custom name, health, and velocity.

      返回:
      实体快照，如果未为此刷怪笼分配任何实体则返回 null。

      原文：the entity snapshot or null if no entities have been assigned to this spawner.

    • addPotentialSpawn

      void addPotentialSpawn(EntitySnapshot snapshot, int weight, @Nullable SpawnRule spawnRule)
      向此刷怪笼可生成的实体列表中添加一个新的 EntitySnapshot。

      权重将决定此条目被选中生成的频率，权重较高的条目将比权重较低的条目更频繁地生成。
      SpawnRule 将决定此条目在什么条件下可以生成，传入 null 将使用给定实体的默认条件。

      原文： Adds a new EntitySnapshot to the list of entities this spawner can spawn.

      The weight will determine how often this entry is chosen to spawn, higher weighted entries will spawn more often than lower-weighted ones.
      The SpawnRule will determine under what conditions this entry can spawn, passing null will use the default conditions for the given entity.

      参数:
      snapshot - 将被生成的快照

      原文：the snapshot that will be spawned

      weight - 权重

      原文：the weight

      spawnRule - 此实体的生成规则，或 null

      原文：the spawn rule for this entity, or null

    • getPotentialSpawns

      java.util.List<SpawnerEntry> getPotentialSpawns()
      获取此刷怪笼的潜在生成列表，如果未为此刷怪笼分配任何实体则返回空列表。
      对返回列表所做的更改不会反映在刷怪笼中，除非通过 setPotentialSpawns(java.util.Collection<org.bukkit.block.spawner.SpawnerEntry>) 应用。

      原文： Gets a list of potential spawns from this spawner or an empty list if no entities have been assigned to this spawner.
      Changes made to the returned list will not be reflected in the spawner unless applied with setPotentialSpawns(java.util.Collection<org.bukkit.block.spawner.SpawnerEntry>)

      返回:
      此刷怪笼的潜在生成列表，如果未为此刷怪笼分配任何实体则返回空列表

      原文：a list of potential spawns from this spawner, or an empty list if no entities have been assigned to this spawner
